responsibility: This implementation module performs pseudo-printf formatting for GNU Modula-2 dynamic strings. It parses format strings, translates escape sequences such as \n, \xhh, and octal escapes, handles %% collapsing, interprets width/justification and basic conversion codes like %s, %d, %x, and %u, and uses DynamicStrings plus StringConvert helpers to build formatted output while optionally integrating with DynamicStrings allocation-debug support. It is the gm2 library’s central text-formatting engine, distinct from simpler numeric conversion modules such as NumberIO or FpuIO.
same_name_distinction: This file is the implementation of the FormatStrings interface, containing the escape parser, percent handling, width/alignment processing, and DynamicStrings-based substitution engine that are only surfaced as procedures in FormatStrings.def.
